nodes.content: Ivy brings the bell's clapper up out of the flooded stair, and Tamsin is there to write down what she saw.
nodes.label: The Low Tide

nodes.content: The tide goes out for nine minutes. Bram rings through all of them; Ivy swims the arcade underneath.
nodes.label: Nine Minutes

nodes.content: Ivy finds the stair the tide charts leave out, and swears to it.
nodes.label: The Drowned Stair

nodes.content: Tamsin reads the season out to the Choir and puts her own name under the numbers.
nodes.label: The Tally

nodes.content: The bell comes down in the dark, and everyone at the stair is paid for what they carried.
nodes.label: The Ninth Bell

nodes.content: Ivy names what the bell was paid, out loud, in front of the Choir.
nodes.label: After the Bell

nodes.content: Holds her breath longer than the bell and keeps what she carries.
nodes.label: Ivy Marrow

nodes.label: Tamsin Quill

nodes.content: The harbour's one gate that stands open when the water is out.
nodes.label: The Low Tide Gate

nodes.content: Where the season is read out and the numbers are signed.
nodes.label: The Tally Room

nodes.content: Nine floors, one bell, and a stair that only shows at the low tide.
nodes.label: The Ninth Bell Tower

nodes.content: A key drawn in chalk on a wet door: it works exactly once.
nodes.label: Chalked Key

nodes.content: A piece of the clapper, still warm, still ringing if nobody holds it.
nodes.label: Bell Fragment

nodes.content: Every bell he rang for the Choir is owed back, with interest.
nodes.label: Bram's debt comes due

nodes.content: Including the part of it that is currently in Ivy's pack.
nodes.label: The Choir wants the bell back

nodes.content:
The Sea Keeps What You Spend
A level costs 600 XP and hands out four points to place.
The tide records each one: +1 Insight, +1 Agility.
What it takes is written down as spent.
nodes.label: [TIDAL LEDGER]

nodes.content:
Type: level_up
Title: The Fourth Entry
Level: 3 → 4
Points: 4
Stat: Insight | 14 → 15
Stat: Agility | 12 → 13
---
Two of the four are written where the ledger already has them. The rest are hers to place.
nodes.label: [TIDAL LEDGER · GAIN]

nodes.content: Points placed into a stat come back as something the water wants.
nodes.label: What if the sea keeps what you spend?

nodes.content: The tally would be paid in the clerk's own chapters, not in XP.
nodes.label: What if a level costs a memory?

nodes.content: The tide goes out, the arcade opens, and the bell has to cover the gap.
nodes.label: Nine minutes of no water

nodes.content: One tide-mark is one month of the harbour, signed and stamped.
nodes.label: Tide-mark: the city's unit of memory

stories.description: A prepared story for trying the whole board: six chapters, a cast whose levels come from what happens in each scene, skills that evolve and are given up, growth points to place, quests, a faction, items, notes and history. Tamsin's third level is recorded at 1,350 XP where the rule says 1,200, so the continuity check has one real disagreement to settle.
